candidates.finding: General electrical table covers 1.7..5.5 V, but current-limit accuracy/product and IQ rows explicitly specify VIN=3.3 V. Existing 65.94..82.21 mA screen is not a 5 V guaranteed bound.
candidates.action: Retain as unqualified candidate; do not promote numerical screen to compliance.

candidates.finding: Startup temporarily raises current limit to 435 mA for 8 ms; sustained overcurrent invokes retry and eventual shutoff.
candidates.reason: Does not enforce the intended low startup limit and is not continuous-limit equivalent.

candidates.finding: ILIM tied to IN yields 50/75/100 mA min/typ/max over operating conditions. This upper output limit leaves no allowance for upstream IC and control supply current under a 100 mA bus budget.
candidates.reason: 100 mA output maximum is not 100 mA total USB input maximum. Do not extrapolate resistor range beyond 232k to claim lower guaranteed limit.

next_step: Screen a low-current continuous limiter with guaranteed USB-voltage bounds and total-input headroom; retain firmware and reduced-component topology as separate candidates.
